LESSON: CARE FOR PLANTS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3.2: care for plants

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about care for plants. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention plants that are found in  Learners to name some plants in the their locality for conservation
2. identify ways of caring for the plants as per the teachings of Islamwithin their school environment
3. Appreciate the need to care for plants in their immediate environment to earn thawab Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving, Citizenship, Learning to learn.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention plants that are found in  Learners to name some plants in the their locality for conservation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention plants that are found in  Learners to name some plants in the their locality for conservation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. identify ways of caring for the plants as per the teachings of Islamwithin their school environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify ways of caring for the plants as per the teachings of Islamwithin their school environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the need to care for plants in their immediate environment to earn thawab Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving, Citizenship, Learning to learn.

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about care for plants.
2. Explain care for plants to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand care for plants.
4. Show that you can: mention plants that are found in  Learners to name some plants in the their locality for conservation
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about care for plants. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is care for plants important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention plants that are found in  Learners to name some plants in the their locality for conservation
2. identify ways of caring for the plants as per the teachings of Islamwithin their school environment
3. Appreciate the need to care for plants in their immediate environment to earn thawab Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving, Citizenship, Learning to learn.
